name: ai.apature/mcp-review
description: In-loop, read-only design review for coding agents: inspect a verified preview, return grounded findings with element refs and fixes, and recheck the agent's fix before CI.

_meta.ai.apature/status: self-hosted. No public endpoint is operated, so this listing intentionally declares no `remotes`: an MCP client reading it cannot be pointed at a host that does not answer. Run the server yourself (see the README), then add the `remotes` entry described by `ai.apature/self_hosted_remote_template` with your own host before submitting this listing to a registry.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <token> or an OAuth-issued access token. Replace <your-mcp-host> with the host you deployed the Streamable HTTP edge on; this template is documentation, not a live endpoint.

_meta.ai.apature/read_only_boundary: Customer-facing: the server judges, explains, and verifies. It never edits code, commits, pushes, or opens pull requests. Submit and recheck create metered jobs; design_review_get and design_review_panel_action are read-only, and a panel apply_fix returns the fix for the caller's coding agent rather than applying it.
